title: Windowed telemetry redriver for idempotent analytics backfills
creator: Sanjay Patel
description: Implement a windowed 'redriver' job to reprocess historical telemetry and derived metrics with per-shard checkpointing, idempotent writes, and lightweight schema-migration mapping. This work addresses multiple outage-induced gaps and late-arriving events by providing a safe, resumable, and resource-aware backfill primitive for the console analytics stack. Key goals: (1) support sub-day windowing to limit blast radius and allow incremental verification, (2) ensure idempotency across destination stores (clickhouse/warehouse/metric-aggregator) via deterministic dedupe keys and upsert semantics, (3) include a dry-run and diff mode to compare pre/post metric samples before committing, (4) protect production ingestion by throttling and adaptive concurrency, and (5) surface progress and reconciliation results in Console so product and SRE can validate backfill correctness.
updates: 2026-02-18: RFC posted with high-level design and constraints; recommended approach is per-customer shard windows with resume tokens and a two-phase commit for final writes.
2026-02-22: Spike completed for idempotency token generation using event hash + model-version + window-start; prototype inserted into dev pipeline and validated for determinism.
2026-02-26: Implemented window checkpoint store using existing redis clusters with TTL and compaction; added pluggable checkpoint backend to support S3 checkpointing for very large runs.

2026-03-01: Dry-run/diff mode added: job can run to compute metric deltas and write diffs to a staging prefix in S3 instead of committing; early diff run against a small customer slice showed <0.05% delta outside expected drift.

2026-03-05: Performance tuning: added rate limiter and concurrency controller to keep downstream write QPS below safe thresholds; integration tests passing on staging; planning canary on 2026-03-10 for low-impact customer segment.
notes: Testing plan: three-phase rollout -> dry-run against 1% sample, canary 5% (read-only validated), full commit with rolling throttles and post-commit reconciliation.

Failure modes: job must be able to rewind to last committed resume token; in the event of schema migration mismatch, job writes diffs to staging and alerts ops channel rather than overwriting production metrics.
Observability: emit per-window metrics (processed_count, deduped_count, commit_latency, s3_staging_size) and attach trace ids to console-run view for debugging.
Operational runbooks and SLO guardrails required before full-run: migration-approval, maintenance-window option for high-risk customers, cost-estimate warning in console.
